UPS provides quantifiable, traceable metrics linking specific digital tools to concrete operational outcomes. DHL, FedEx, and Maersk rely predominantly on qualitative narratives, strategic language, and case studies that describe digital activity without establishing performance accountability. In the absence of standardised disclosure frameworks for DSCC performance, digital transformation claims in logistics remain structurally unverifiable, a condition that limits investor accountability, obstructs cross-firm benchmarking, and leaves regulators without the evidentiary basis needed for meaningful scrutiny. The paper argues that the logistics industry requires independently developed, sector-specific reporting standards that treat digital capability claims with the same rigour currently applied to financial disclosures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析DHL、FedEx、马士基和UPS四家全球物流巨头2021-2025年的年报和可持续发展报告，发现这些公司在数字化转型披露上存在严重不对称：只有UPS提供了可量化的指标将数字工具与运营绩效挂钩，其他三家主要依赖定性叙事。论文呼吁物流行业建立独立、标准化的数字能力披露框架。
AI.research_question: 全球物流巨头如何披露其数字供应链能力（DSCCs），这些披露是否建立了与运营关键绩效指标（KPI）之间可验证的联系？
AI.motivation: 尽管物流企业普遍声称数字化转型带来可衡量的运营改善，但这一主张缺乏独立验证，且存在披露实践的不对称性，导致投资者问责受限、跨企业对标受阻、监管缺乏证据基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（RBV）、动态能力理论（Dynamic Capabilities Theory）、技术-组织-环境模型（TOE模型）
AI.method: 对DHL、FedEx、马士基和UPS四家企业2021-2025年年报和可持续发展报告进行定性主题分析。
AI.findings: 四家企业均宣称数字投资的战略价值，但披露实践存在显著不对称：UPS提供了可量化、可追溯的指标将具体数字工具与运营结果挂钩；DHL、FedEx和马士基主要依赖定性叙述、战略语言和案例研究，描述数字活动但未建立绩效问责。在缺乏标准化DSCC绩效披露框架的情况下，物流行业的数字化转型主张在结构上无法被验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将RBV、动态能力理论和TOE模型整合应用于物流数字化转型披露研究，揭示了现有理论在评估数字能力绩效验证方面的不足，为构建数字能力披露的标准化框架提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出物流行业需要独立开发的、行业特定的报告标准，以对待财务披露的同等严谨性对待数字能力主张，从而提升投资者问责、促进跨企业对标、为监管提供证据基础。

title: More Channels, Lower Scores: Entertainment Television and Student Achievement
affiliations: Universita di Cagliari, Università degli Studi di Milano - Dipartimento di Economia Politica e Aziendale (DEPA), DiSea & CRENOS, Università di Sassari and Bocconi University - BAFFI Center on International Markets, Money, and Regulation

detail.title: More Channels, Lower Scores: Entertainment Television and Student Achievement
detail.abstract: We study the effects of expanded entertainment television on children's academic performance leveraging the staggered transition from analog to digital TV across Italian provinces between 2008 and 2012, which greatly increased children's entertainment content, and administrative data on standardized test scores for entire cohorts of primary and middle school students. Availability of digital TV reduced literacy and math performance by 0.08 and 0.12 standard deviations, respectively, implying effects of −0.20 and −0.30 standard deviations among children who acquired access to digital TV along the transition. Effects are larger among younger children and among students attending school only in the morning.

AI.tldr: 本文利用意大利各省在2008年至2012年间从模拟电视向数字电视逐步过渡的自然实验，研究发现数字电视的普及显著降低了小学生的语文和数学成绩，分别下降0.08和0.12个标准差，且对低龄儿童和只上半天学的学生影响更大。
AI.research_question: 娱乐电视内容的增加对儿童学业表现有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 随着数字电视的普及，儿童可接触的娱乐内容大幅增加，但其对学业成绩的因果效应尚缺乏严谨的证据。意大利各省分阶段从模拟电视过渡到数字电视为识别这一因果效应提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间置换理论（娱乐电视挤占了学习、阅读等有益活动的时间）和注意力分散理论（娱乐内容损害认知专注力）。
AI.method: 利用意大利各省在2008-2012年间逐步从模拟电视转向数字电视的准自然实验，结合全体小学生的标准化考试成绩行政数据，采用双重差分（DID）或事件研究法进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 数字电视的普及使儿童语文成绩下降0.08个标准差，数学成绩下降0.12个标准差；在获得数字电视的儿童中，效应分别扩大至-0.20和-0.30个标准差。低龄儿童和仅上半天学的学生受到的影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"媒体时间置换假说"提供了因果层面的实证证据；揭示了娱乐内容冲击对学生认知发展的负向影响，丰富了教育生产函数和传媒经济学相关理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了数字媒体对儿童学业影响的因果证据，建议在电视数字化进程中考虑对儿童的保护措施；提示家长和教育者合理管控儿童娱乐屏幕时间。

title: On the Unintended Consequence of Fiscal Rules: Evidence from Fiscal Expenditures
affiliations: ,  and Vietnam National University (VNU)

detail.title: On the Unintended Consequence of Fiscal Rules: Evidence from Fiscal Expenditures
detail.abstract: This paper documents the unintended consequence of fiscal rules in the form of tax expenditures using both theory and data. We first introduce a simple fiscal model where the government has time-inconsistent preferences with a present bias toward public spending in line with Halac and Yared (2014). We then empirically validate the main prediction of the model by providing evidence that the adoption of a binding fiscal rule on public spending leads to an increase in tax expenditures, whereas revenue rules, which do not constrain spending, leave them unaffected. Our findings suggest the existence of a robust "innovation channel" in the fiscal domain—paralleling regulatory capital requirements in banking.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论和实证角度证明了财政规则（特别是约束公共支出的规则）会导致税收支出增加这一非预期后果，类似于银行业监管资本要求引发的"创新渠道"。
AI.research_question: 财政规则（尤其是约束公共支出的规则）是否会意外导致税收支出增加？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注财政规则对赤字和债务的直接影响，但对其可能产生的非预期后果（如通过税收支出规避约束）研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Halac和Yared（2014）的政府时间不一致偏好模型，引入公共支出的现时偏差偏好。
AI.method: 理论模型推导与实证检验相结合。实证部分检验约束性支出财政规则与税收支出之间的因果关系。
AI.findings: 约束公共支出的财政规则会导致税收支出增加；而约束收入的财政规则（不限制支出）对税收支出无显著影响。这揭示了财政领域的"创新渠道"——类似于银行业资本监管要求引发的监管规避行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"创新渠道"概念从银行业监管引入财政领域，为财政规则的非预期后果提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者在设计财政规则时需关注税收支出这一潜在规避渠道，避免规则效果被削弱。

title: Russia and Syria: Trade and Economic Cooperation in the Context of Regime Change
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Russia and Syria: Trade and Economic Cooperation in the Context of Regime Change
detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolution and current state of Russian-Syrian trade and economic cooperation against the backdrop of the radical geopolitical and political transformations in late 2024. Long established as a key strategic and economic partner for Russia in the Middle East, Syria’s recent regime change raises critical questions regarding the future stability of bilateral trade flows, particularly in essential sectors such as grain, fuel, pharmaceuticals, and industrial equipment. Additionally, this study analyzes how ongoing international sanctions complicate logistics, banking transactions, and major infrastructure investment. Ultimately, the paper provides a practical and theoretical framework for understanding how political transitions reshape foreign trade priorities and the displacement or retention of traditional international partnerships in the region.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2024年底地缘政治剧变背景下俄叙贸易与经济合作的演变，探讨叙利亚政权更迭对双边贸易流（尤其是粮食、燃料、药品和工业设备等关键领域）稳定性的影响，以及国际制裁对物流、银行交易和基础设施投资的制约。
AI.research_question: 2024年底叙利亚政权更迭如何影响俄叙双边贸易与经济合作？国际制裁在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 叙利亚作为俄罗斯在中东的关键战略与经济伙伴，其政权更迭可能根本性改变双边贸易格局，但现有文献对政治转型如何重塑贸易伙伴关系的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治转型对外贸优先级的重塑理论；传统国际合作伙伴关系在区域内的位移或保留机制。
AI.method: 基于2024年底地缘政治与政治转型背景的定性分析，结合俄叙贸易流（粮食、燃料、药品、工业设备）的实证数据与制裁影响评估。
AI.findings: 叙利亚政权更迭对俄叙双边贸易稳定性构成重大挑战；国际制裁显著复杂化了物流、银行交易和基础设施投资；政治转型导致贸易优先级重构，部分传统伙伴关系可能被保留或位移。
AI.theory_contributions: 为政治转型如何重塑外贸优先级及传统国际合作伙伴关系的位移/保留提供了理论和实践框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业理解叙利亚政权更迭后俄叙贸易的可持续性及制裁环境下的应对策略提供参考。

title: Employee Retention: Investigation of the Critical Core Factors that Have the Greatest Impact on Employee Retention in School Bus Companies in Panama City

detail.title: Employee Retention: Investigation of the Critical Core Factors that Have the Greatest Impact on Employee Retention in School Bus Companies in Panama City

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently as part of an academic dissertation requirement with no external funding or organizational influence.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research was conducted in accordance with the Dublin Business School Code of Ethics. All participants — including four owner-managers and 53 bus drivers — provided informed consent prior to participation. Anonymity was assured for all questionnaire respondents and participation was entirely voluntary.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was completed as part of the academic requirements for the Masters in Business Administration (MBA) in Human Resources program at Dublin Business School, Ireland.

detail.abstract: The aim of this research is to investigate the critical HR factors that have the greatest impact on employee retention in School Bus Companies in Panama City. This gives the opportunity to identify and address different internal and external environmental factors that can impact employee retention based on managers' and drivers' opinions. This research also allows the researcher to identify organisational variables that affect the drivers' satisfaction and motivation levels. This research is also aiming to determine the impact of leadership on employee retention and the preferable leadership styles among drivers in the School Bus Companies in Panama City. In addition, it also looks into understanding the job and role demands that can affect employee retention. The literature review identified several factors that seem to have an influence on employee retention. These internal and environmental factors have been implemented as the base of the research. These factors include Recruitment and Selection, Training and Development, Work-Life Balance, Job Satisfaction, Leadership, Motivation and Performance as well as Organisational Culture and Work Environment, Psychological Contract and Commitment, Compensations and Rewards, and Communication. This study is carried out in three School Bus Companies in Panama City, focusing on the four owners acting as managers as well as the 53 drivers. Managers together with drivers share their opinions regarding different internal and external factors but most importantly about employee retention. Based on the findings, the researcher was able to identify four main variables that had the greatest influence on employee retention. These elements are communication, motivation, job satisfaction and leadership. Similarly, the findings also conclude that in the school bus driving industry in Panama City, nonmonetary rewards seem to be more important than monetary rewards highlighting that compensation is not as important as communication. In addition, this research also proposes a theoretical working model in order to increase employee retention levels. The model focuses on the four key elements (communication, leadership, motivation and satisfaction) found throughout this research and includes different internal and external factors that can have an impact on employee retention.

AI.tldr: 本研究聚焦巴拿马城校车公司员工留任的关键HR因素，通过对管理层和司机的调查，发现沟通、动机、工作满意度和领导力是影响员工留任的四大核心变量，且非货币奖励比货币补偿更为重要，并据此提出了一个理论工作模型。
AI.research_question: 哪些关键HR因素对巴拿马城校车公司员工留任影响最大？领导力对员工留任的影响及司机偏好的领导风格是什么？工作与角色需求如何影响员工留任？
AI.motivation: 校车司机作为关键岗位，离职率高会影响企业运营稳定性。通过识别影响员工留任的内外部因素，帮助企业制定更有效的留人策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资源管理理论、员工留任理论、领导力理论；关键因素包括：招聘选拔、培训发展、工作生活平衡、工作满意度、领导力、动机与绩效、组织文化与工作环境、心理契约与承诺、薪酬奖励、沟通。
AI.method: 在三家巴拿马城校车公司开展实地研究，研究对象包括4名所有者（兼任管理者）和53名司机，通过收集管理者与司机的意见进行质性或量化分析。
AI.findings: 四大核心变量：沟通、动机、工作满意度、领导力；非货币奖励的重要性高于货币奖励，薪酬不如沟通重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了以沟通、领导力、动机、满意度为核心要素的员工留任理论工作模型，整合了影响留任的内外部因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴拿马城校车公司管理者提供了明确的员工留任策略方向，强调非货币激励（尤其是沟通）比加薪更有效。

title: Twin-Anchor Fair Volatility and Cascaded Gate Selection for Short-Volatility Option Structures Public Release
affiliations: Yale University

detail.title: Twin-Anchor Fair Volatility and Cascaded Gate Selection for Short-Volatility Option Structures Public Release
detail.abstract: Short-volatility selection usually stacks uncoupled rules: IV rank, delta strikes, return-onrisk, and a single probability heuristic. We specify an alternative coupled pipeline: Gatheral SVI defines fair implied vol σ IVfair ; Longstaff-Schwartz Monte Carlo prices American legs at σ IVfair (not at market IV); per-leg volatility edge uses joint vol-dollar residuals net of costs; a three-stage probability cascade (P RN → P real → P eff) feeds both managed-loss expectancy and Kelly sizing; expected shortfall normalized by structure max loss gates tail risk before booking; competing structure classes share one gate algebra and lexicographic rank. We contrast this framework with conventional practice, state eight methodological contributions (twin-anchor fair pricing, dual-channel edge, cascaded probability, managed-loss entry, structure ES gate, unified competition, regime-split prescreen vs gates, American-European consistency boundary), and derive the pricing operators (Black-Scholes, Crank-Nicolson, Dupire, SVI, LSM, binomial). Operational calibration is omitted (Section 1).

AI.tldr: 提出了一种耦合的短期波动率选择框架，替代传统解耦规则，包含SVI公允定价、LSM美式期权定价、联合波动率-美元残差、三级概率级联、预期短缺风控及统一结构排名系统。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个系统化、耦合的短期波动率选择框架，以替代传统解耦规则并提升风险调整后收益？
AI.motivation: 传统短期波动率选择方法（IV分位数、Delta行权价、回报风险比、单一概率启发式）各自独立运作，缺乏系统性耦合，导致定价不一致、风险管理碎片化。
AI.theoretical_framework: Gatheral SVI波动率模型、Longstaff-Schwartz蒙特卡洛美式期权定价、Black-Scholes/Crank-Nicolson/Dupire定价算子、三级概率级联（风险中性→真实→有效）、期望损失（ES）风控、凯利准则仓位管理。
AI.method: 提出耦合管道：SVI定义公允隐含波动率→LSM以公允波动率定价美式期权→联合波动率-美元残差计算边缘→三级概率级联→管理损失期望与凯利仓位→ES归一化风控→统一结构排名。
AI.findings: 八项方法论贡献：双锚公允定价、双通道边缘、级联概率、管理损失入场、结构ES门控、统一竞争机制、制度拆分预筛选与门控对比、美式-欧式一致性边界。推导了定价算子。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出耦合波动率选择框架，将SVI公允定价、LSM美式定价、三级概率转换、ES风控整合为统一系统，丰富了波动率套利与期权定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波动率交易者提供了一套系统化的结构选择、风险控制和仓位管理流程，可提升策略一致性与尾部风险管理能力。

title: When to Broaden, When to Focus: Job Search and Market Tightness

detail.title: When to Broaden, When to Focus: Job Search and Market Tightness
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether directing job search toward tight labor markets improves re-employment. Such targeting is theoretically attractive as it reduces aggregate congestion. I link Swiss unemployment records to clickstream search data to measure which markets jobseekers target. To address selection, I exploit quasi-random assignment to caseworkers differing in their tendency to redirect clients toward tight markets. Moving from the 10th to the 90th percentile raises six-month job-finding by 2.7%. The channels are heterogeneous: jobseekers who become unemployed in slack markets gain from mobility, consistent with prior findings from policies that encourage broader search. The new insight is that jobseekers who become unemployed in tight markets benefit from a narrower focus on this initial market. Effects are orthogonal to other caseworker behaviors and do not come at the expense of job quality. My findings suggest that market tightness offers a simple basis for targeted search advice.

AI.tldr: 本文利用瑞士失业登记数据与网页点击流数据，结合个案工作者的准随机分配，发现引导求职者瞄准紧张劳动力市场（从第10百分位升至第90百分位）可使六个月再就业率提高2.7%。在宽松市场失业者通过流动性获益，在紧张市场失业者则因聚焦初始市场而受益，且不影响工作质量。
AI.research_question: 引导求职者瞄准紧张劳动力市场是否以及如何提高再就业概率？
AI.motivation: 理论上，引导求职者向紧张市场流动可减少整体拥挤效应，但此前缺乏因果证据；同时需要区分不同劳动力市场状况（宽松 vs 紧张）下求职者的异质性反应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场拥挤理论、搜寻与匹配理论、市场紧度（market tightness）对再就业影响的异质性分析。
AI.method: 将瑞士失业登记行政数据与求职者网页点击流搜索数据匹配，利用个案工作者（caseworker）的准随机分配作为外生冲击，识别引导求职者瞄准紧张市场的因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）从第10百分位升至第90百分位，六个月再就业率提高2.7%；（2）异质性：在宽松市场失业者通过跨区域流动性获益，在紧张市场失业者则因聚焦初始市场而受益；（3）该效应独立于个案工作者的其他行为，且不损害工作质量。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次为“引导求职者瞄准紧张市场可减少拥堵”提供因果证据；（2）揭示市场紧度的异质性作用：初始市场条件不同，最优搜索策略不同；（3）证明市场紧度可作为简单有效的搜索建议基础指标。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为就业服务机构提供基于市场紧度的简单、低成本搜索指导策略；（2）表明针对不同失业背景的求职者应采取差异化建议（宽松市场鼓励流动，紧张市场鼓励聚焦）；（3）政策制定者可在不牺牲工作质量的前提下提高再就业效率。

title: Recursive Intelligence in Medicine: A Human-AI Synergy Framework for the EHR Era

detail.title: Recursive Intelligence in Medicine: A Human-AI Synergy Framework for the EHR Era

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
Context: As artificial intelligence becomes deeply integrated into clinical practice, the medical profession faces a choice that has not been adequately framed in either the health policy or informatics literature. This article introduces Human-AI Synergy as a framework for that choice, grounded in a model of Recursive Human-AI Interaction that reconceives the relationship between physician and AI as iterative and mutually generative rather than competitive or simply assistive. 

Methods: Drawing on industrial organization theory, cognitive science, and institutional economics, the article develops a structural analysis of how electronic health records have created the informational architecture that currently shapes AI integration in clinical settings, and why that architecture, left unreformed, produces what this article terms the validation trap. 

Findings: EHRs have gradually shifted the physician's epistemic role from primary evaluator to interpreter of a pre-structured record over three decades. AI systems are optimized for exactly the standardized environment EHRs have created, accelerating a narrowing of clinical judgment that is individually unremarkable but cumulatively transformative. Errors embedded in the longitudinal record are not merely propagated across encounters but operationalized through AI training, compounding the structural risk. 

Conclusions: The dominant automation-versus-augmentation frame in healthcare AI policy is inadequate. Human-AI Synergy, realized through Recursive Human-AI Interaction, offers a superior framework for EHR and AI system design. Four design principles and policy recommendations for healthcare organizations, regulators, medical educators, and technology vendors are offered.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人类-人工智能协同"框架，基于递归人机交互模型，批判了现有电子健康记录(EHR)体系导致"验证陷阱"——AI在标准化环境中加速窄化临床判断，并放大病历中的累积错误。文章提出四个设计原则和政策建议。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能深度融入临床实践的背景下，医疗行业应如何选择人机关系的框架？现有的"自动化vs增强"二分法是否充分？
AI.motivation: AI与临床实践的融合日益深入，但健康政策与信息学文献中缺乏对该"选择"的适当框架性讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类-人工智能协同(Human-AI Synergy)框架；递归人机交互(Recursive Human-AI Interaction)模型；产业组织理论、认知科学、制度经济学。
AI.method: 基于产业组织理论、认知科学和制度经济学的结构性分析，考察EHR如何塑造了AI整合的信息架构，以及该架构如何导致"验证陷阱"。
AI.findings: (1) EHR在三十年间将医生的认知角色从"主要评估者"转变为"预结构化记录的解释者"；(2) AI优化于EHR创造的标准化环境，加速了临床判断的窄化；(3) 病历中的错误不仅被跨就诊传播，还通过AI训练被操作化，放大了结构性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"验证陷阱"概念，揭示EHR架构下AI放大累积性错误的机制；引入"递归人机交互"模型替代传统的竞争或简单辅助范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构、监管者、医学教育者和技术供应商提供四个设计原则和政策建议，指导EHR与AI系统的设计改进。

title: Acuity Adjusted Nurse Staffing and Patient Processes and Outcomes in an Emergency Department: A Retrospective Longitudinal Study
affiliations: University College Dublin, University of Southampton - Faculty of Environment and Life Sciences, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Southampton - University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust, University of Southampton, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, KU Leuven and University College Cork - School of Public Health

detail.title: Acuity Adjusted Nurse Staffing and Patient Processes and Outcomes in an Emergency Department: A Retrospective Longitudinal Study
detail.abstract: Background: Emergency departments are experiencing crowding and delays in care, which are associated with poorer patient outcomes. Nurse staffing is a key determinant of patient throughput and outcomes, but much of the existing research relies on indicators such as average nurse-to-patient ratios that do not account for daily variation in patient acuity. Acuity-adjusted measures of staffing that reflect the balance between available nursing hours and patient care requirements may provide a more accurate understanding of how nurse staffing affects emergency department performance.Objective: To examine the association between nurse staffing, adjusted for daily case-mix acuity, and patient processes and outcomes. Design: Retrospective longitudinal study.Setting: Emergency department of a university hospital. Participants: Administrative data from 67,010 patients corresponding to 115,078 adult visits over 787 consecutive days.Methods: Routinely collected emergency department data from January 2018 to February 2020 were analysed, with each 24-hour period as the unit of analysis. Actual nursing hours were taken from rosters. Required nursing hours were estimated by linking each patient’s Manchester Triage System category to a pre-determined nursing care time. A staffing deficit was defined as actual minus required hours. Process measures were time to triage, and wait to be seen; outcome measures were patient experience time, and leaving without being seen. Models were run unadjusted and adjusted for potential confounders.Results: On average, 85% of visits were triaged as urgent or very urgent. On 88% of days, actual nursing hours were below the estimated requirement. Median times were 21 minutes to triage, 2.1 hours to be seen, and a median of 7.0 hours total patient experience time. Staffing deficits were associated with poorer patient processes and outcomes (p < 0.001). Each 5-hour deficit (versus no deficit) in nurse staffing was associated with a 21% increase in time to triage (RGM 1.21; 95% CI 1.19 to 1.23), a 12% increase in wait to be seen (RGM 1.12; 95% CI 1.09 to 1.14), a 7% increase in patient experience time (RGM 1.07; 95% CI 1.05 to 1.09), and 16% higher odds of a patient leaving without being seen (OR 1.16; 95% CI 1.11 to 1.22). Conclusions: Lower nurse staffing relative to patient acuity was associated with delays across all stages of care and more patients leaving without being seen. An acuity-adjusted staffing metric provides a more accurate relationship between staffing and patient need than simple nurse-to-patient ratios supporting its use in determining safe emergency department staffing.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于67,010名患者、115,078次成人急诊就诊及787天的数据，发现护士人力相对患者病情的短缺与急诊全过程延误（从分诊到离院）及患者未就诊即离开的概率增加显著相关。研究采用经每日病例组合 acuity 调整的 staffing 指标，比简单护患比更准确反映人力与患者需求的关系。
AI.research_question: 经每日病例组合 acuity 调整后的护士 staffing 与急诊患者流程和结局之间有何关联？
AI.motivation: 急诊科拥挤和护理延误导致患者预后更差，而现有研究多使用平均护患比等指标，未考虑每日患者 acuity 的变化。 acuity 调整后的 staffing 指标能更准确反映可用的护理工时与患者护理需求之间的平衡，从而更好地理解护士 staffing 如何影响急诊绩效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 护士 staffing 与患者 acuity 的匹配理论：实际护理工时与基于患者 acuity 所需的护理工时之间的差值（staffing deficit）作为核心解释变量，反映人力供给与需求的不平衡状态。
AI.method: 回顾性纵向研究。以每24小时为分析单位，分析2018年1月至2020年2月的急诊数据。实际护理工时来自排班记录；所需护理工时通过将每位患者的曼彻斯特分诊系统类别与预设的护理时间关联估算。自变量为 staffing deficit（实际工时减所需工时）。因变量包括过程指标（分诊时间、候诊时间）和结局指标（患者体验时间、未就诊即离开）。运行未调整和调整潜在混杂因素的模型。
AI.findings: 88%的天数中实际护理工时低于估计需求。每5小时staffing deficit与分诊时间增加21%（RGM 1.21; 95% CI 1.19-1.23）、候诊时间增加12%（RGM 1.12; 95% CI 1.09-1.14）、患者体验时间增加7%（RGM 1.07; 95% CI 1.05-1.09）以及患者未就诊即离开的几率增加16%（OR 1.16; 95% CI 1.11-1.22）显著相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了 acuity 调整后的 staffing 指标比简单的护患比更能揭示 staffing 与患者需求之间的真实关系，为急诊安全 staffing 的度量方法提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为急诊科管理者提供了基于 acuity 的动态 staffing 决策工具，支持将 acuity 调整后的 staffing 指标用于确定安全急诊 staffing 标准，以减少患者等待时间和未就诊即离开的比例。

title: The Information Curse in Turbulent Supply Chains: Expectations-Based Reference Dependence and Operational Efficiency
affiliations: ,  and Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management

detail.title: The Information Curse in Turbulent Supply Chains: Expectations-Based Reference Dependence and Operational Efficiency

publicationDetails.journalName: HKUST Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: To navigate unpredictable supply chain turbulence, firms increasingly invest in advanced predictive analytics, operating on the classical assumption that more information enhances supply chain decisions. However, this paradigm overlooks the behavioral realities of corporate planning, where managers evaluate realized outcomes against anticipated operational targets. We investigate this dynamic using a principalagent model in which a manager chooses between a conservative supply chain option with certain returns and an aggressive alternative with higher operating benefits but uncertain disruption costs. Crucially, before the manager forms a plan, the Board of Directors determines the firm's information architecture: they decide whether to adopt an advanced system that provides the complete probability distribution of the disruption risk, making the manager fully informed, or to rely on a basic system that yields only a single deterministic signal, leaving the manager partially informed. Assuming the manager exhibits expectations-based, reference-dependent preferences, our analysis reveals a novel "information curse": providing complete predictive transparency often degrades the firm's supply chain efficiency while simultaneously increasing the manager's ex-ante expected utility. For the manager, full information acts as a psychological buffer that perfectly calibrates expectations and minimizes painful gain-loss shocks. Yet, this stabilization induces behavioral hesitation, driving sub-optimal physical execution. In contrast, a partially informed manager treats a limited signal as deterministic, bypassing the burden of over-comparison and frequently achieving higher objective efficiency. Finally, we establish that structural cost reductions inversely impact efficiency and managerial utility across information states. Our findings caution that corporate boards must strictly coordinate policy levers with their push for digitization, ensuring that advanced transparency does not merely create "illusive happiness" for the agent at the expense of the firm.

AI.tldr: 本文通过委托代理模型揭示了一个"信息诅咒"：为管理者提供完全透明的预测信息反而会降低供应链效率，虽然它能提升管理者的期望效用。部分信息下管理者反而能做出更优决策。
AI.research_question: 公司采用高级预测分析系统（完全信息透明度）是否会改善供应链决策效率？信息透明度对管理者的心理和行为产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 现实中企业大量投资高级预测分析，但忽视了管理者在计划制定中的行为现实——管理者会基于参照点评估实际结果。传统"信息越多越好"的假设可能不成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理模型（principal-agent model）；基于期望的参照依赖偏好（expectations-based, reference-dependent preferences）；行为经济学中的参照点依赖理论。
AI.method: 理论建模（principal-agent模型），博弈论分析。董事会先决定信息架构（完全透明vs有限信号），管理者再选择供应链方案（保守型vs激进型）。
AI.findings: 1) "信息诅咒"：完全信息透明度降低供应链效率但提升管理者期望效用；2) 完全信息作为"心理缓冲"精确校准预期，减少得失冲击，但导致行为犹豫和次优执行；3) 部分信息下管理者将有限信号视为确定性，避免过度比较，实现更高客观效率；4) 结构性成本降低在不同信息状态下对效率和效用的影响相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将参照依赖偏好引入供应链信息架构研究，挑战了"信息越多越好"的传统假设，提出"信息诅咒"概念，丰富了行为运营管理和信息经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 企业董事会在推进数字化和预测分析投资时，必须谨慎协调政策杠杆与信息透明度，避免"虚假幸福"——即管理者心理舒适但企业效率受损的局面。

title: Strategic Intelligence Architecture for Business Intelligence-Enabled Supply Chain Intermediation in Emerging Markets: Insights from Vietnam's Agricultural and Chemical Sector

detail.title: Strategic Intelligence Architecture for Business Intelligence-Enabled Supply Chain Intermediation in Emerging Markets: Insights from Vietnam's Agricultural and Chemical Sector
detail.abstract:
Business Intelligence (BI) has become a critical strategic capability for supply chain intermediaries operating in volatile commodity markets, yet evidence from asset-light trading firms in Southeast Asia remains limited. This study develops and validates a four-layer Strategic Intelligence Architecture (SIA) for LAEXIM, a Vietnamese startup engaged in agricultural inputs, industrial chemicals, and premium wines.

Using ten proprietary Vietnamese customs datasets (2015–2025) covering 31,259 shipment records across agricultural chemicals, fertilizers, rice, cashew kernels, feed ingredients, coated paper, and industrial chemicals, the study provides a comprehensive analysis of price volatility, supply concentration, and working capital risks within Vietnam’s commodity trading ecosystem.

Key findings indicate: (i) heavy dependence on China for critical agricultural chemicals (SA: 91.2%; NH4Cl: 95.8%); (ii) substantial commodity price volatility affecting procurement costs; (iii) strong growth in the hydrogen peroxide market; (iv) significant pricing variation across export destinations for cashew products; (v) large-scale rice export flows requiring advanced logistics and compliance capabilities; (vi) complex multi-origin sourcing structures in coated paper imports; and (vii) persistent information asymmetries disadvantaging domestic SME traders.

The proposed SIA combines an ETL-based data warehouse, predictive pricing models, supplier reliability scoring, and executive KPI dashboards. Financial simulations suggest net margin improvements of 1.5–2.0 percentage points, inventory cost reductions of 15–20%, and a payback period of less than one month. The study contributes to BI strategy, supply chain analytics, and emerging-market SME research by offering an empirically grounded framework applicable to commodity trading firms across Southeast Asia.

AI.tldr: 本研究为越南初创贸易公司LAEXIM开发并验证了一个四层战略智能架构（SIA），基于越南2015–2025年十大海关数据集（31,259条记录），通过ETL数据仓库、预测定价模型、供应商可靠性评分及KPI仪表盘，帮助中小型商品贸易企业降低信息不对称、改善利润率1.5–2.0个百分点、降低库存成本15–20%，并实现不到一个月的投资回收期。
AI.research_question: 在波动性大宗商品市场中，资产较轻的供应链中介（特别是东南亚初创贸易企业）如何通过战略智能架构（SIA）提升商业智能能力，以应对价格波动、供应集中度及营运资金风险？
AI.motivation: 商业智能（BI）已成为大宗商品市场中供应链中介的关键战略能力，但来自东南亚资产轻型贸易企业的实证证据十分有限。越南初创企业LAEXIM面临信息不对称、价格波动、供应集中等典型挑战，亟需一套可落地的智能分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略智能架构（SIA）四层体系：ETL数据仓库层、预测定价模型层、供应商可靠性评分层、执行KPI仪表盘层；融合BI战略、供应链分析及新兴市场中小企业研究。
AI.method: 基于越南十大专有海关数据集（2015–2025年），涵盖31,259条货运记录，涉及农业化学品、化肥、大米、腰果仁、饲料原料、涂布纸及工业化学品；采用数据仓库构建、预测建模、供应商评分及财务模拟等方法。
AI.findings: (i) 对中国的农业化学品高度依赖（SA: 91.2%; NH4Cl: 95.8%）；(ii) 大宗商品价格波动显著影响采购成本；(iii) 过氧化氢市场强劲增长；(iv) 腰果产品出口目的地价格差异大；(v) 大米出口流量大，需先进物流与合规能力；(vi) 涂布纸进口呈现复杂的多来源采购结构；(vii) 信息不对称持续使国内中小企业处于劣势。财务模拟显示净利率提升1.5–2.0个百分点，库存成本降低15–20%，回收期不足一个月。
AI.theory_contributions: 为BI战略和供应链分析提供了基于实证的四层SIA框架，填补了东南亚新兴市场中小企业商品贸易领域的研究空白，展示了数据驱动决策在降低信息不对称方面的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LAEXIM及东南亚同类商品贸易企业提供了可直接落地的智能分析工具（ETL数据仓库、预测模型、供应商评分、KPI仪表盘），并量化了利润率提升、库存成本降低及投资回收期的实际商业价值。

title: Regime-Dependent Predictability in the SBIR Phase II to Venture Capital Pipeline: Evidence from 8332 U.S. Awardees, 2010-2022
affiliations: and

detail.title: Regime-Dependent Predictability in the SBIR Phase II to Venture Capital Pipeline: Evidence from 8332 U.S. Awardees, 2010-2022

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The corresponding author (Tamaz Khunjua) is the founder of Zeoba Limited, whose data infrastructure (the Loturo platform) underlies this study; the co-author (Julia Malik) is an employee of Zeoba Limited. The research design, methodology, numerical results, and interpretations are independent of any commercial interest. The data redistributed in the public replication package is name-stripped at the firm level (re-linkable from public SBIR records) and contains no proprietary linking fields. The authors report no other competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available administrative records (SBIR/STTR awards and SEC Form D filings) and involves no human subjects
declarations.funderStatement: None. No external funds, grants, or other support were received for the preparation of this manuscript.

detail.abstract: We document regime-dependent predictability in the U.S. SBIR Phase II to venture capital pipeline. On 8332 Phase II SBIR/STTR awardees indexed 2010-2022, concordance falls from 0.668 under random crossvalidation to 0.565 under strict time-split validation; within-regime validation partially recovers it, localising the implied regime change to 2018-2019. The gap survives nine robustness corrections and replicates on the broader Phase I sample (n = 14 156): the predictive axis (firm-trajectory and embedding features) replicates there, while the behavioral axis (grant cadence, submission timing) attenuates, consistent with survivor selection. A regime-aware specification yields a top-decile lift of 1.50× (95% CI [1.06, 1.99]).

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国SBIR Phase II到风险投资管道的制度依赖可预测性，发现2018-2019年间存在制度转换，导致时间序列预测精度下降，但制度感知模型能部分恢复预测性能。
AI.research_question: 美国SBIR Phase II到风险投资管道是否存在制度依赖的可预测性？制度转换发生在何时？
AI.motivation: 理解政府创新资助（SBIR/STTR）向私人风险资本转化的可预测性及其制度依赖性，对政策制定和投资决策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度转换理论、预测模型的时间稳定性、幸存者选择偏误
AI.method: 随机交叉验证与严格时间分割验证对比；制度内验证；9种稳健性检验；Phase I样本复制（n=14,156）；制度感知预测模型
AI.findings: 一致性指数从随机交叉验证的0.668下降到时间分割验证的0.565；制度转换定位在2018-2019年；预测轴特征（企业轨迹和嵌入特征）可复制，行为轴特征（资助节奏、提交时间）衰减；制度感知模型顶层分位提升1.50倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政府资助-风险投资管道的制度依赖可预测性，界定了制度转换的具体时间窗口，区分了预测轴与行为轴特征的不同稳定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者优化SBIR/STTR项目评估提供时间敏感性证据；为风险投资者提供制度感知的预测工具，提升投资筛选效率约50%。

title: The Digitalization of Arbitration in Africa: Enhancing Access to Justice or Entrenching Inequality?

detail.title: The Digitalization of Arbitration in Africa: Enhancing Access to Justice or Entrenching Inequality?
detail.abstract:
The digitalization of arbitration has emerged as one of the most significant developments in contemporary dispute resolution. Accelerated by the COVID-19 pandemic, arbitral institutions and practitioners across the world have increasingly adopted virtual hearings, electronic filings, and online case management systems.2 In Africa, where arbitration continues to grow as a mechanism for resolving commercial disputes, digital technologies present an opportunity to improve efficiency and expand access to justice.3 However, the shift towards digital arbitration also raises critical concerns regarding fairness, equality, and inclusivity.

This paper examines whether the digitalization of arbitration in Africa enhances access to justice or risks entrenching existing socio-economic inequalities. It argues that while digital arbitration has the potential to democratize dispute resolution by removing geographical barriers and lowering procedural costs, its benefits remain unevenly distributed due to infrastructural disparities, technological illiteracy, and the persistent digital divide. Through an evaluation of African arbitration institutions, the paper demonstrates that digital arbitration must be implemented cautiously to safeguard procedural fairness. The paper concludes that digitalization should complement rather than replace traditional arbitration mechanisms. This piece further suggests that regulatory reform and digital infrastructure development is essential to ensure that technological innovation strengthens access to justice.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨非洲仲裁数字化在促进司法可及性与加剧社会不平等之间的张力，认为数字化应补充而非取代传统仲裁，并提出监管改革和数字基础设施建设的必要性。
AI.research_question: 非洲仲裁数字化是增强了司法可及性，还是加剧了现有的社会经济不平等？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情加速了全球仲裁数字化进程，非洲仲裁也在增长，但数字化带来的公平性、平等性和包容性问题亟待审视，尤其考虑到非洲存在严重的数字鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法可及性理论；数字鸿沟理论；程序公正理论
AI.method: 对非洲仲裁机构的评估分析
AI.findings: 数字仲裁虽能消除地理障碍、降低成本，但由于基础设施差距、技术文盲和持续的数字鸿沟，其收益分布不均；数字化应补充而非取代传统仲裁机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字鸿沟与程序公正理论引入仲裁数字化讨论，揭示了技术 adoption 中的不平等结构性因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲仲裁机构和政策制定者提供建议：需进行监管改革和数字基础设施建设，确保技术创新切实增强而非削弱司法可及性。

title:
Bifurcated Cross-Sectional Inference on Continuous Commodity Futures

A Roll-Aware Fusion Architecture with Mandatory Directional Exposure and Orthogonal Priority Ranking
affiliations: Yale University

detail.title:
Bifurcated Cross-Sectional Inference on Continuous Commodity Futures

A Roll-Aware Fusion Architecture with Mandatory Directional Exposure and Orthogonal Priority Ranking
detail.abstract: We present a mathematical proof-of-concept for daily cross-sectional scanning of vendor-spliced commodity continuous futures. The framework departs from the dominant long-flat-short paradigm: every symbol receives a mandatory Buy or Sell label-there is no neutral, hold, or abstain state at the inference layer-while conviction magnitude lives in a continuous composite C i and an orthogonal priority score Opp i. The contribution is architectural. We show how roll-calendar skepticism, disciplined volatility state estimation, dual-layer headline sentiment, short-horizon drift, and simulated path diagnostics can be fused into a signed decision rule whose internal disagreements are surfaced but not silently overridden. This manuscript supplies conceptual equations, explanatory figures, and descriptive documentation for interpreting cross-sectional scan outputs. Calibrated parameter values are application-specific and omitted here for brevity.

title: Investor Disputes in Nigeria: Arbitration, Litigation and Enforcement Risks Every Investor Should Understand

detail.title: Investor Disputes in Nigeria: Arbitration, Litigation and Enforcement Risks Every Investor Should Understand
detail.abstract: Foreign investors should plan carefully for disputes in Nigeria, a large emerging economy with a pro-arbitration stance. Nigeria is a party to the ICSID Convention and the New York Convention 1 , 2 and its modern Arbitration and Mediation Act of 2023 (AMA) incorporates these treaties into domestic law 3. 4. In practice this means that, when properly structured, arbitration agreements and awards are generally upheld and enforceable. Below we examine key aspects of dispute clauses, forum and law choices, enforcement of awards/judgments, interim relief, and common pitfalls for foreign parties. All points are supported by Nigerian statutes and case law or expert commentary, as cited. Arbitration Clauses in Contracts Nigeria's arbitration law is now largely based on the UNCITRAL Model Law.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了尼日利亚作为大型新兴经济体中的仲裁法律环境，为外国投资者提供争议解决条款设计、法律选择、裁决执行等方面的实务指导。
AI.research_question: 外国投资者如何在尼日利亚有效规划争议解决策略？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚是大型新兴经济体且支持仲裁，但外国投资者需了解当地法律环境以避免常见陷阱。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于《ICSID公约》《纽约公约》《仲裁与调解法》(AMA)及《UNCITRAL示范法》等法律框架。
AI.method: 基于尼日利亚法律法规、案例法和专家评述的规范性分析。
AI.findings: 尼日利亚的仲裁协议和裁决通常可被支持与执行，但需注意条款设计的合规性。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了尼日利亚仲裁法律框架及其对外国投资者的实践意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外国投资者提供了仲裁条款设计、法律选择、裁决执行、临时救济等方面的实务建议。

title: The Gender Diversity in Leadership Roles:-An Analytical Review
affiliations: University of Delhi

detail.title: The Gender Diversity in Leadership Roles:-An Analytical Review
detail.abstract: This study examines why women in Indian companies often enter the workforce in strong numbers but rarely reach senior leadership and what is actually causing that gap. Rather than relying on surveys or self-reported opinions, the research uses audited figures drawn directly from official company filings that businesses are legally required to publish. Four major Indian companies were studied across two industries: TCS and Nykaa (technology sector), and ICICI Bank and HDFC AMC (banking and finance), covering the financial years 2023 to 2025. There are certain findings which state that women recruited in bulk but there certain barries which restrict the growth of women into senior leadership position because of workplace bias , rigid structure , family duties , motherhood penalties etc… The inclusion women diversity is a crucial strategy to majour growth of any organisations and for future sustainability. Gender diversity contributes improvies innovation governance retention and decision making , thus stronger female participation at the entry level paves way for women to seniority level positions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用印度四家大型企业（TCS、Nykaa、ICICI Bank、HDFC AMC）2023-2025年官方审计数据，发现女性在入职阶段占比可观，但因职场偏见、僵化结构、家庭责任和母职惩罚等障碍，晋升至高级领导层的比例极低。
AI.research_question: 为什么印度企业女性员工基数庞大，却极少进入高级领导层？造成这一"漏斗式"性别差距的根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多依赖自陈式问卷调查，存在主观偏差；本研究采用法律强制披露的官方审计数据，旨在更客观地揭示女性职业发展中的真实阻碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别平等与领导力多样性理论；组织行为学中关于职场偏见、组织结构刚性、性别角色期待（如母职惩罚）的相关理论。
AI.method: 基于印度四家知名企业（TCS、Nykaa、ICICI Bank、HDFC AMC）2023-2025财年的官方公开审计数据，进行跨行业（科技与银行金融）比较分析。
AI.findings: 女性在入职阶段大量被招聘，但面临职场偏见、组织结构僵化、家庭责任负担、母职惩罚等多重障碍，导致晋升至高级领导层的比例严重偏低。
AI.theory_contributions: 以审计数据替代主观调查，为"漏斗式"性别领导力差距提供了更可靠的实证依据；揭示了从入职到高层过程中多重障碍的累积效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他新兴市场企业提供数据驱动的性别多样性策略建议，强调通过消除系统性偏见和结构性障碍来促进女性从基层向高层流动，以提升组织创新、治理、保留率和决策质量。

title: Internal vs. External Barriers to Green Supply Chain Management (GSCM): An Empirical Study of Egypt's Petrochemical Sector
affiliations: , Effat University and

detail.title: Internal vs. External Barriers to Green Supply Chain Management (GSCM): An Empirical Study of Egypt's Petrochemical Sector
detail.abstract: This study addresses the critical problem of barriers hindering Green Supply Chain Management (GSCM) adoption in Egypt's petrochemical sector, a major economic driver that produces approximately 4.5 million tons annually but generates significant GHG emissions and hazardous waste. The objective is to identify, rank, and analyze the hierarchical relationships among internal and external barriers using a mixed-methods approach. This study focuses on the full petrochemical supply chain in Egypt, encompassing upstream (raw material sourcing), midstream (manufacturing/refining processes), and downstream (distribution, waste management, reverse logistics), with an emphasis on emission/waste reduction practices. Data were collected via a structured questionnaire from 400 employees in Egyptian petrochemical firms and analyzed using Interpretive Structural Modeling (ISM). The findings showed that internal impediments, such as a lack of corporate leadership and support (IB1), a critical shortage of resources (IB6), and the absence of green initiatives (IB5), serve as driving forces that exert a cascading influence over the external barriers, which include insufficient government support (EB1), a lack of markets for recycled materials (EB5), and human resources or expertise shortages (EB7). The study contributes to the existing literature on GSCM by incorporating international trends and specifically addressing Egyptian issues, including weak policies, difficult supply chains, high energy-intensive operations, and costly operations. The study suggests that sending clear messages from the top and providing financial incentives can help push the obstacles aside and guide the industry down the path of environmentally responsible operations.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法，通过结构方程模型对埃及石化行业400名员工进行调查，发现内部障碍（如缺乏领导支持、资源短缺、绿色倡议缺失）是驱动外部障碍（如政府支持不足、再生材料市场缺乏、人才短缺）的根本原因，为埃及石化行业绿色供应链管理采纳提供了层次化分析框架。
AI.research_question: 埃及石化行业绿色供应链管理采纳面临哪些内部和外部障碍？这些障碍之间的层级关系如何？
AI.motivation: 埃及石化行业年产约450万吨，但产生大量温室气体排放和危险废物，绿色供应链管理采纳面临严重阻碍。目前缺乏针对埃及石化行业全供应链（上游、中游、下游）障碍的层次化分析研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 解释结构模型（ISM）；绿色供应链管理（GSCM）理论；障碍层级理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：对埃及石化企业400名员工进行结构化问卷调查，运用解释结构模型（ISM）进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 内部障碍（缺乏企业领导支持、资源短缺、绿色倡议缺失）是驱动外部障碍（政府支持不足、再生材料市场缺乏、人才短缺）的根本原因，内部障碍对外部障碍具有层级递进影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将国际绿色供应链管理趋势与埃及本土问题相结合，揭示了内部障碍对外部障碍的层级驱动机制，拓展了GSCM障碍研究的国别情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议企业高层发出明确信号并提供财务激励以消除障碍，为埃及石化行业向环境负责任运营转型提供实践路径。

title: A Multi-Dimensional Labeling System for "Fixed Income Plus" Fund Managers: An Integrated Approach Combining Quantitative Metrics, Portfolio Structure, and Large Language Model Analysis

detail.title: A Multi-Dimensional Labeling System for "Fixed Income Plus" Fund Managers: An Integrated Approach Combining Quantitative Metrics, Portfolio Structure, and Large Language Model Analysis
detail.abstract: Background: With the rapid expansion of "fixed income plus" (FI+) fund products-including secondary bond funds and convertible bond funds-investors increasingly demand tools for manager style identification and performance attribution. Conventional fund evaluation relies on single quantitative metrics or opaque qualitative ratings, which fail to capture the multi-dimensional nature of FI+ strategies. Objective: This study constructs a six-dimensional labeling system for FI+ fund managers by integrating quantitative metrics, portfolio structure, and large language model (LLM) textual analysis, and systematically compares fund performance across label combinations. Methods: We select 25 representative FI+ funds (15 secondary bond funds + 10 convertible bond funds) from January 2022 to December 2024. Three analytical layers are employed: (1) nine quantitative indicators computed from daily net-asset-value (NAV) data; (2) bond-type classification and credit-downgrade analysis based on portfolio holdings; and (3) structured text analysis of 224 fund periodic reports using DeepSeek Chat large language model via API (temperature = 0.1). A six-dimensional label system is built covering "return-risk profile," "operating style," "drawdown control," "equity style," "interest-rate band," and "credit style." Findings: (1) Low-volatility funds (annualized volatility < 3%) achieved an average return of 2.4%, significantly outperforming high-volatility funds at-2.33% (Kruskal-Wallis test, *p* < 0.05). (2) "Left-side layout" funds exhibited a significantly higher Sharpe ratio (0.38) than "right-side follower" funds (-0.13)(Wilcoxon rank-sum test, W = 15, p = 0.042). (3) Managers with a neutral sentiment expression outperformed those with dominant optimism (annualized 0.58% vs.-1.72%). (4) Credit-downgrade strategies did not generate excess returns during the sample period. Implications: The labeling framework provides an objective, quantifiable toolkit for fund screening, performance attribution, and product design. The methodology is replicable and extensible to other fund categories.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个六维度"固收+"基金标签体系，结合定量指标、持仓结构与LLM文本分析，对25只基金进行系统比较。研究发现：低波动基金显著跑赢高波动基金；"左侧布局"型基金夏普比率更高；中性情绪表达的基金经理表现优于乐观型；信用下沉策略未产生超额收益。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个多维度、客观的"固收+"基金标签体系，以识别基金经理风格并进行绩效归因？
AI.motivation: 随着"固收+"基金产品（二级债基、可转债基）的快速扩张，投资者迫切需要工具进行基金经理风格识别和绩效归因。传统的基金评价依赖单一量化指标或不透明的定性评级，无法捕捉"固收+"策略的多维特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多维度标签分类理论，整合三大分析层：定量指标（九种NAV指标）、持仓结构分析（债券类型分类、信用降级分析）、LLM文本分析（DeepSeek Chat对224份基金定期报告的结构化分析）。构建六维标签体系：收益-风险特征、操作风格、回撤控制、权益风格、利率波段、信用风格。
AI.method: 选取2022年1月至2024年12月期间25只代表性固收+基金（15只二级债基+10只可转债基）。采用三层分析：（1）基于日净值数据的九个定量指标；（2）基于持仓的债券类型分类与信用降级分析；（3）基于DeepSeek Chat大语言模型API（温度参数=0.1）对224份基金定期报告的结构化文本分析。
AI.findings: (1)低波动基金（年化波动率<3%）平均收益率2.4%，显著高于高波动基金的-2.33%（Kruskal-Wallis检验，p<0.05）；(2)"左侧布局"型基金夏普比率（0.38）显著高于"右侧跟随"型基金（-0.13）（Wilcoxon秩和检验，W=15，p=0.042）；(3)中性情绪表达的基金经理跑赢乐观型（年化0.58% vs -1.72%）；(4)信用下沉策略在样本期内未产生超额收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将LLM文本分析引入"固收+"基金风格识别领域，构建了多维度标签体系，突破了传统单一指标评价的局限，为基金风格分类提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了可量化、客观的基金筛选和绩效归因工具包；标签体系具有可复制性和可扩展性，可推广至其他基金类别；为产品设计提供了参考依据。

title: Aid Transitions and Agricultural Productivity: Evidence from Zimbabwe and Zambia after 2000

detail.title: Aid Transitions and Agricultural Productivity: Evidence from Zimbabwe and Zambia after 2000
detail.abstract: This paper describes the structural impacts of foreign aid delivery methods on agricultural sector performance, distinguishing between long-term development capital and short-term humanitarian relief. Leveraging a post-2000 policy divergence where donors redirected Zimbabwe's capital aid entirely into humanitarian relief for political reasons while maintaining Zambia's structural lines, I evaluate a macro-panel of caloric land productivities (1980-2024). Panel estimations (FGLS and autoregressive) show that shifting to humanitarian aid correlated with a severe structural contraction: an immediate 41.32% yield drop that deepens to a 47.78% long-run cumulative loss. These results formalize the "humanitarian trap," demonstrating that emergency relief cannot substitute for capital accumulation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用津巴布韦和赞比亚在2000年后的政策差异，发现将发展资本援助转为 humanitarian relief 会导致农业产出严重且持续的结构性下降（短期41.32%，长期47.78%），证明了“人道主义陷阱”的存在。
AI.research_question: 外国援助方式（长期发展资本 vs. 短期人道主义救济）如何影响农业部门的结构性绩效？
AI.motivation: 澄清发展资本和人道主义救济对农业产出的差异化影响，并验证“人道主义陷阱”（emergency relief无法替代资本积累）的假说。
AI.theoretical_framework: “人道主义陷阱”理论：紧急救济不能替代资本积累；发展经济学中的资本积累与农业生产率关系。
AI.method: 利用2000年后津巴布韦（资本援助被转为 humanitarian relief）和赞比亚（保持结构性援助）的政策差异作为自然实验，使用1980-2024年的宏观面板数据，采用可行广义最小二乘法（FGLS）和自回归模型进行估计。
AI.findings: 向人道主义援助的转变导致卡路里土地生产率立即下降41.32%，长期累积损失达47.78%。
AI.theory_contributions: 正式化和量化了“人道主义陷阱”概念，证明了 emergency relief 无法替代发展资本对农业生产率的长期作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为援助政策制定者提供证据：应避免将发展资本大规模转为短期人道主义救济，否则将导致农业部门严重的结构性衰退。

title: Machine Learning for Predictive Analytics for Agricultural Water Sustainability
affiliations: The British University in Dubai

detail.title: Machine Learning for Predictive Analytics for Agricultural Water Sustainability
detail.abstract: Agricultural water sustainability has become a critical global concern due to climate change, increasing water scarcity, population growth, and the rising demand for food production. Traditional irrigation and water management approaches often fail to optimize water use efficiency and respond effectively to dynamic environmental conditions. This study explores the role of machine learning (ML) in predictive analytics for improving agricultural water sustainability through intelligent decision-making, real-time monitoring, and data-driven forecasting models. The research examines how advanced ML algorithms, including regression models, neural networks, decision trees, and deep learning techniques, can analyse large-scale agricultural and environmental datasets to predict irrigation requirements, soil moisture levels, crop water demand, drought risks, and climate variability. Furthermore, the study highlights the integration of Internet of Things (IoT), remote sensing technologies, geographic information systems (GIS), and big data analytics to enhance precision agriculture and sustainable water resource management. The paper also discusses the benefits of predictive analytics in reducing water waste, increasing crop productivity, improving resource allocation, and supporting environmental sustainability objectives. In addition, challenges related to data quality, cybersecurity, infrastructure limitations, model uncertainty, and implementation costs are critically evaluated. The findings indicate that machine learning-driven predictive systems can significantly improve agricultural water management efficiency and contribute to resilient and sustainable farming ecosystems. The study concludes by emphasizing the importance of interdisciplinary collaboration, policy support, and technological innovation to accelerate the adoption of intelligent water sustainability solutions in modern agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨机器学习在农业用水可持续性预测分析中的作用，通过智能决策、实时监测和数据驱动模型提升水资源管理效率，并讨论了IoT、遥感等技术的整合应用及面临的挑战。
AI.research_question: 机器学习驱动的预测分析如何改善农业用水可持续性？
AI.motivation: 气候变化、水资源短缺、人口增长和粮食需求上升使农业用水可持续性成为全球性关键问题，而传统灌溉方法难以优化用水效率和应对动态环境变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测分析理论、机器学习算法（回归模型、神经网络、决策树、深度学习）、精准农业理论、可持续水资源管理理论
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，探讨ML算法在农业环境大数据中的应用框架，以及IoT、遥感、GIS与大数据分析技术的整合路径。
AI.findings: 机器学习驱动的预测系统能显著提升农业水管理效率，预测灌溉需求、土壤湿度、作物需水量、干旱风险和气候变异性，减少水资源浪费，提高作物生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了机器学习预测分析在农业水管理中的理论框架，明确了ML算法与精准农业、可持续水资源管理理论的结合路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业从业者和政策制定者提供了基于数据驱动的智能水管理解决方案，强调了跨学科合作、政策支持和技术创新的重要性，有助于构建有韧性的可持续农业生态系统。

title: Anti-Camping Ordinances, State Preemption, and the Arrest of People Experiencing Homelessness: Evidence from Orange County, Florida
affiliations: University of Central Florida and University of Central Florida

detail.title: Anti-Camping Ordinances, State Preemption, and the Arrest of People Experiencing Homelessness: Evidence from Orange County, Florida
detail.abstract: Anti-camping laws have proliferated across American state and local governments, intertwined with the Supreme Court's 2024 Grants Pass v. Johnson decision that further allowed their legal authority. Research has documented the harmful effects of these laws and others targeting behaviors associated with homelessness for unhoused persons from their perspectives, but little has analyzed the enforcement patterns. We examine this question using administrative jail booking records from Orange County, Florida (N = 96,669 bookings, January 2022-June 2025), including both the implementation of a local anti-camping ordinance in January 2024 and a statewide preemption law in January 2025. Using an interrupted time series design, we estimate the association between each policy's implementation and weekly homeless bookings and the composition of charges. Although camping charges about tripled after the state preemption law compared to before, the local ordinance associates with no detectable change in homeless bookings or camping-specific enforcement, making attribution to the ordinance uncertain. The rise is likely a result of a rising rate of arrests prior to the law. However, there are large increases in arrests of unhoused persons from open-container laws (400%) and share of arrests that are homeless-targeting charges (38%). Collectively, these findings imply that post-policy enforcement dynamics likely reflected a combination of ongoing trends, broader policing or governance changes, and evolving homelessness conditions rather than a singular causal effect of the local ordinance or state law.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用佛罗里达州奥兰治县9.6万余条监狱记录，采用中断时间序列设计分析当地反露营法令（2024年1月）与州级优先法（2025年1月）实施后对无家可归者逮捕模式的影响。结果发现：州优先法后露营指控约增3倍，但当地法令无显著影响；无家可归者因公开携带酒类被捕数量暴增400%，针对无家可归者的指控比例上升38%。总体而言，执法变化更可能反映持续趋势、警务变革及流浪状况演变，而非单一政策的因果效应。
AI.research_question: 针对无家可归者的反露营法律及其相关禁令在实施后，其执法模式（尤其是逮捕模式）发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注无家可归者视角下这些法律的危害，但鲜少系统分析执法模式的实际变化，本研究旨在填补这一实证空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中断时间序列设计（Interrupted Time Series），政策评估与执法模式分析。
AI.method: 基于佛罗里达州奥兰治县2022年1月至2025年6月的行政监狱记录（N=96,669条），采用中断时间序列设计，评估当地反露营法令（2024年1月）与州级优先法（2025年1月）实施前后，每周无家可归者逮捕数量及指控构成的关联变化。
AI.findings: 1）州优先法后露营指控约增3倍，但当地法令无显著可检测变化；2）无家可归者因公开携带酒类被捕数量暴增400%；3）针对无家可归者的指控占比上升38%。综合表明，执法变化更可能源于持续趋势、更广泛的警务或治理变革以及流浪状况演变，而非单一政策的直接因果效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了反露营法律在真实执法中的复杂动态，挑战了将执法变化简单归因于单一政策因果效应的假设，强调需区分政策效应与其他并发因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和执法机构提供实证依据，表明反露营法律的实施效果可能被高估或误判，实际执法变化可能受更宏观因素驱动，提示需审慎评估此类法律的真实社会影响。

title: Quantifying Digital Harm to Minors: A Risk-Scoring Framework for Litigation, Insurance, and Policy

detail.title: Quantifying Digital Harm to Minors: A Risk-Scoring Framework for Litigation, Insurance, and Policy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Founder and CEO of TeenAegis, the organization whose methodology is described in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: The adolescent mental health crisis attributable to social media platform design has generated one of the most consequential waves of mass tort litigation in American legal history. Yet the field lacks a standardized, defensible methodology for quantifying the magnitude of harm that individual platforms impose on minors-a gap that impedes litigation strategy, insurance underwriting, school procurement decisions, and evidence-based policy. This paper proposes the TeenAegis Digital Harm Index (DHI), a multi-dimensional risk-scoring framework adapted from financial risk quantification methodology and applied to the specific harm vectors documented in academic research, regulatory findings, and litigation discovery. Drawing on credit risk scoring architecture, Basel III operational risk principles, and ESG materiality frameworks, the DHI scores platforms across five harm dimensions: algorithmic amplification, design exploitability, data extraction intensity, crisis response adequacy, and jurisdictional compliance posture. The framework produces a composite score on a 0-100 scale, enabling comparative platform benchmarking, trend monitoring, and expert witness testimony grounded in a reproducible, peer-reviewable methodology. Applications for plaintiff counsel, reinsurance underwriters, school district procurement officers, and state legislators are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TeenAegis数字危害指数（DHI），一个借鉴金融风险量化方法（如信用评分、巴塞尔III操作风险原则和ESG实质性框架）的多维风险评估框架，用于量化社交媒体平台对未成年人造成的伤害，涵盖算法放大、设计可利用性、数据提取强度、危机响应充分性和司法合规态势五个维度，产出0-100的综合评分。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个标准化、可辩护的方法来量化社交媒体平台对未成年人造成的伤害程度？
AI.motivation: 美国因社交媒体平台设计导致的青少年心理健康危机引发了大规模侵权诉讼浪潮，但该领域缺乏标准化的损害量化方法，这一空白阻碍了诉讼策略制定、保险承保、学校采购决策和循证政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用风险评分架构、巴塞尔III操作风险原则、ESG实质性框架
AI.method: 将金融风险量化方法适配到社交媒体伤害领域，构建包含五个危害维度的多维风险评分框架（DHI），并产出0-100的综合评分。
AI.findings: DHI框架能够实现平台间的比较基准测试、趋势监控，并为专家证人证词提供可复制、可同行评审的方法论基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融领域的风险量化方法（信用评分、操作风险、ESG）跨学科迁移应用到数字平台对未成年人伤害的评估中，为侵权法领域提供了标准化的损害计量工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为原告律师、再保险承保人、学区采购官员和州立法者分别提供了可操作的分析工具，支持诉讼策略、保险定价、采购决策和政策制定。

title: An Analytical Framework to Analyze Challenges and Opportunities for Medical Tourism in Host (Developing) Countries
affiliations: , School of Management, IIT Bombay and Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business

detail.title: An Analytical Framework to Analyze Challenges and Opportunities for Medical Tourism in Host (Developing) Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: none
declarations.ethicsApproval: none
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: Medical tourism creates an important policy trade-off for host countries. Foreign patients can generate revenue for private hospitals and support healthcare-sector growth, but they may also draw capacity away from domestic patients who rely on the same private providers and the public hospital system. We study when medical tourism benefits or harms domestic patients and society in the host country, and how policymakers can regulate the balance between foreignpatient demand from developed countries and domestic healthcare access in developing countries. Methodology/results: We develop an analytical model of a host country healthcare market with a private hospital, a public hospital, domestic patients, and foreign medical tourists. The model captures hospitals' capacity and pricing decisions and patients' hospital choices. We compare outcomes with and without medical tourism and examine two policy levers: public hospital capacity and restrictions on the private hospital's foreign-to-domestic capacity mix. We find that medical tourism can reduce domestic patient welfare by shifting private capacity toward foreign patients, but its effect on overall welfare depends on the cost of expanding private capacity and on how prices, congestion, profits, and market coverage adjust. Public capacity can discipline private hospital behavior, while proportionality rules that link foreign-patient capacity to domestic-patient capacity can protect domestic access. Managerial implications: The paper provides a framework for evaluating medical tourism through data-driven country contextualization. Using publicly available country and healthcare-market data, we show how the same policy can have different welfare consequences across host countries. In cost-driven settings such as India, policy should protect domestic access and redistribute provider-side gains, whereas in highly internationalized settings such as Thailand, regulating the private hospital's foreign-to-domestic capacity mix is more effective. The model helps decision makers tailor medical tourism policy to measurable local conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了医疗旅游对东道国国内患者和社会福利的影响，发现医疗旅游可能通过将私立医院产能转向外国患者而损害国内患者福利，但整体福利影响取决于私立产能扩张成本、价格、拥堵、利润和市场覆盖的调整。公共医院产能和外国-国内患者产能比例限制是两种有效政策工具。政策效果因国家情境而异：成本驱动型国家（如印度）应保护国内就医并再分配供给方收益，高度国际化国家（如泰国）则应监管私立医院的产能混合比例。
AI.research_question: 医疗旅游何时有益或有害于东道国的国内患者和社会福利？政策制定者如何调节发达国家外国患者需求与发展中国家国内医疗可及性之间的平衡？
AI.motivation: 医疗旅游为东道国带来重要的政策权衡：外国患者可为私立医院创收并支持医疗部门增长，但可能占用原本服务国内患者的产能（包括私立和公立医院资源）。现有文献缺乏对这一政策权衡的系统性分析，尤其是缺乏可指导政策制定的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文构建了一个东道国医疗市场的分析模型，包含一家私立医院、一家公立医院、国内患者和外国医疗游客。模型捕捉了医院的产能和定价决策以及患者的医院选择行为。
AI.method: 分析模型（analytical model），通过比较有/无医疗旅游的情境，并检验两种政策杠杆：公共医院产能、私立医院外国-国内患者产能混合比例限制。结合公开可用的国家与医疗市场数据进行情境化分析。
AI.findings: (1) 医疗旅游可能将私立产能转向外国患者，从而降低国内患者福利；(2) 整体福利影响取决于私立产能扩张成本、价格、拥堵、利润和市场覆盖的调整；(3) 公共产能可约束私立医院行为；(4) 将外国患者产能与国内患者产能挂钩的比例规则可保护国内医疗可及性；(5) 同一政策在不同国家（如印度 vs. 泰国）的福利后果不同，政策需因国制宜。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模医疗旅游对东道国国内患者福利和整体社会福利的双重影响，揭示了产能约束、价格调整和市场竞争之间的互动机制，为医疗旅游政策设计提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于可测量本地条件定制医疗旅游政策的框架：在成本驱动型国家（如印度）应优先保护国内就医并通过再分配机制平衡供给方收益；在高度国际化国家（如泰国）应侧重监管私立医院的产能混合比例。

title: Coherent Drawdown-Adjusted Performance: Replication and Extension Across International Equity Markets

detail.title: Coherent Drawdown-Adjusted Performance: Replication and Extension Across International Equity Markets
detail.abstract: Mechanical drawdown rules are among the most widely used risk management tools in institutional trading, yet their statistical properties remain poorly understood. This paper extends Varma (2025) by replicating and testing the Coherent Drawdown-Adjusted Performance (CDAP) metric out-of-sample across European equity ETFs and a range of drawdown thresholds motivated by pod shop practice. Using rolling 22-day windows over 1993–2024, we confirm that traditional Drawdown-Adjusted Performance (DAP) ranked the worst 22-day window across four major crises - the Dot-com crash, the GFC, COVID, and the 2022 rate shock - between the 8th and 25th percentile for SPY in every case, treating each event as unremarkable, while CDAP correctly ranked all four windows in the bottom 2% of the full sample. This pathology generalises: DAP ranked the same period at approximately the 32nd percentile for both EWU and EWG, while CDAP ranked it below the 0.1th percentile in both cases. Threshold sensitivity analysis shows that Millennium-style 5% drawdown rules applied to SPY since 1993 produce a terminal portfolio value of 5x versus 24x for buy-and-hold, with 280 individual transactions. These results suggest that mechanical drawdown rules substantially underperform buy-and-hold benchmarks across equity markets and that CDAP offers a more coherent basis for risk-adjusted evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文复制并扩展了Varma (2025)的Coherent Drawdown-Adjusted Performance (CDAP)指标，通过欧洲ETF数据样本外检验发现：传统Drawdown-Adjusted Performance (DAP)在四大危机中均将最差22天窗口排名在第8-25百分位（严重低估风险），而CDAP正确将其排在后2%。机械回撤规则（如5%止损）长期表现远不及买入持有策略。
AI.research_question: 传统机械回撤规则（Drawdown规则）的统计性质如何？CDAP指标是否能更准确地评估风险调整后的投资绩效？
AI.motivation: 机械回撤规则在机构交易中被广泛使用，但其统计性质尚未被充分理解。Varma (2025)提出了CDAP指标，本文旨在通过样本外检验验证其有效性，并揭示传统DAP指标的病理缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于回撤调整的风险绩效评估框架，对比传统DAP（回撤调整绩效）与CDAP（一致回撤调整绩效）两种指标的理论逻辑差异。
AI.method: 使用滚动22天窗口，覆盖1993-2024年数据，对SPY、EWU、EWG等欧洲股权ETF进行样本外分析；采用Millennium-style 5%回撤规则进行阈值敏感性分析。
AI.findings: （1）DAP在四次重大危机（互联网泡沫、全球金融危机、新冠、2022利率冲击）中均将最差窗口排在第8-25百分位（SPY），严重低估风险；CDAP正确将其排在后2%。（2）对EWU和EWG，DAP将相同期间排在第32百分位，CDAP排在第0.1百分位以下。（3）5%回撤规则下SPY终端价值仅为买入持有的5倍（vs 24倍），产生280笔交易。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了传统DAP指标存在系统性风险低估的病理特征，验证了CDAP作为更一致风险调整评估指标的有效性，为回撤风险测度理论提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对机构交易实践有重要警示：广泛使用的机械回撤规则（如5%止损）长期大幅跑输买入持有策略；建议使用CDAP替代传统DAP进行风险调整后绩效评估。

title: Monetary Policy Transmission and Equity Market Performance in Ghana: Nonlinear, Distributional, and Time-Frequency Evidence
affiliations: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) and Transilvania University of Brasov

detail.title: Monetary Policy Transmission and Equity Market Performance in Ghana: Nonlinear, Distributional, and Time-Frequency Evidence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Human Ethics, Consent to Participate, and Consent to Publish: Human Ethics, Consent to Participate, and Consent to Publish: not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Monetary policy transmission to equity markets in frontier economies remains incompletely understood, particularly regarding nonlinear dynamics, distributional heterogeneity, and structural instability. This study investigates how monetary policy shocks affect equity market performance in Ghana-a frontier economy characterised by persistent macroeconomic volatility, shallow financial markets, and recurrent structural breaks-over the period January 2007 to December 2024 (N = 216 monthly observations). We employ a multi-method framework integrating Bayesian Quantile Regression (BQR), Toda-Yamamoto augmented VAR causality testing, impulse response functions (IRF), forecast error variance decomposition (FEVD), and continuous Morlet wavelet coherence analysis. Zivot-Andrews structural break unit root tests account for endogenous breaks associated with the 2008-2009 Global Financial Crisis, the 2014-2015 exchange rate crisis, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the 2022-2023 sovereign debt and inflation crisis. Monetary policy rate shocks are associated with statistically significant, asymmetric, and quantile-dependent negative effects on both the Ghana Stock Exchange Composite Index (GSE-CI) and the Financial Stock Index (GSE-FSI), with the largest contractionary effects concentrated at upper return quantiles. Toda-Yamamoto tests indicate unidirectional causality from monetary policy to equity returns. Wavelet coherence identifies medium-run co-movement (6-18 months) as the dominant transmission band, while FEVD estimates attribute approximately 21.4 percent of forecast error variance in GSE-CI returns to monetary policy innovations at a twelve-month horizon. These findings have practical relevance for investors managing interest rate risk, policymakers balancing disinflation against capital market development, and regulators designing macroprudential frameworks in frontier market contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文采用多方法框架（贝叶斯分位数回归、Toda-Yamamoto因果检验、脉冲响应、方差分解和小波相干分析），研究了2007-2024年间加纳这一前沿经济体中货币政策冲击对股票市场的非线性、非对称和结构性不稳定的传导效应，发现货币政策利率冲击对股市回报具有显著的负向且分位数依赖的影响，最大紧缩效应集中在上分位数，且存在从货币政策到股票回报的单向因果关系。
AI.research_question: 在前沿经济体中，货币政策冲击如何影响股票市场表现？这种影响是否存在非线性动态、分布异质性和结构性不稳定特征？
AI.motivation: 前沿经济体的货币政策传导至股票市场的机制仍未得到充分理解，特别是在非线性动态、分布异质性和结构性不稳定方面存在研究空白。加纳作为典型的宏观经济持续波动、金融市场浅薄且存在反复结构性断裂的前沿经济体，为回答这一问题提供了理想的实证场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制理论（利率渠道、资产价格渠道）；分位数回归框架下的非对称效应理论；小波相干分析中的时频域传导理论。
AI.method: 多方法框架：贝叶斯分位数回归（BQR）、Toda-Yamamoto增强型VAR因果检验、脉冲响应函数（IRF）、预测误差方差分解（FEVD）、连续Morlet小波相干分析。采用Zivot-Andrews结构断裂单位根检验控制内生性结构断裂。
AI.findings: (1) 货币政策利率冲击对加纳股市指数（GSE-CI和GSE-FSI）具有统计显著的非对称负向效应，且存在分位数依赖性，紧缩效应在上分位数最强烈；(2) Toda-Yamamoto检验表明存在从货币政策到股票回报的单向因果关系；(3) 小波相干分析识别出6-18个月的中期传导频带为主导传导区间；(4) FEVD显示货币政策创新约解释GSE-CI回报12个月预测误差方差的21.4%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为前沿经济体的货币政策-股市传导机制提供了非线性、分位数依赖和时频域的新证据；揭示了中期传导频带（6-18个月）的主导地位；验证了结构性断裂对传导关系的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者管理利率风险提供量化参考；为政策制定者在平衡通胀抑制与资本市场发展之间提供实证依据；为监管者设计前沿市场宏观审慎框架提供具体数据支持。

title: Media Over Intermediaries: Edutainment, Gender, and Social Change in Upper Egypt
affiliations: Yale University, Institute for Advanced Study in Toulouse (IAST), Toulouse School of Economics and Columbia University

detail.title: Media Over Intermediaries: Edutainment, Gender, and Social Change in Upper Egypt
detail.abstract: Can narrative entertainment dislodge harmful practices-and if so, how can such changes be measured unobtrusively? We report results from a randomized edutainment intervention in Egypt, in which participants were assigned to view a state-backed drama targeting female genital mutilation (FGM) and early marriage, family planning, or a placebo storyline. Outcomes were measured through surveys and interviewerblinded conversations six months later, analyzed at scale using large language models. The FGM drama increased opposition to the practice, driven by corrections to health and religious misperceptions-corrections the state cannot reliably engineer through local intermediaries, who undermine it. Effects for family planning, which does not face such opposition, were weak and inconsistent. Interview-based measures reveal the spontaneous salience of FGM without elevated signs of respondent re-traumatization. Edutainment works when the state lacks trusted messengers on the ground, and these boosts can be ethically captured by incorporating open-ended measurement into experimental evaluations.

AI.tldr: 在埃及进行的一项随机教育娱乐干预实验表明，针对女性割礼（FGM）的电视剧能够有效改变有害习俗，其作用机制是纠正健康与宗教方面的错误认知；这种效果在政府缺乏可信本地信使的议题上尤为显著，而通过开放式对话结合大语言模型分析，可以实现对变化的非侵入式测量。
AI.research_question: 叙事性娱乐节目能否消除有害习俗？如果能，如何以非侵入式的方式测量这种变化？
AI.motivation: 有害习俗（如女性割礼）长期存在且难以改变，政府通过本地中介传递信息的效果常被削弱，需要探索更有效的干预手段及非侵入式的评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育娱乐理论（Edutainment）、社会规范改变理论、信息传递中的中介信任机制、大语言模型在定性数据分析中的应用。
AI.method: 在埃及进行随机对照实验，参与者被分配观看针对女性割礼、早婚、计划生育或安慰剂剧情的电视剧；六个月后通过调查和访谈者不知情的对话收集结果，并使用大语言模型进行大规模分析。
AI.findings: 女性割礼剧增加了反对该习俗的态度，效果由纠正健康和宗教错误认知驱动；而政府通过本地中介传递信息时，这些中介反而会削弱纠正效果。计划生育议题（不面临类似中介反对）的效果较弱且不稳定。访谈测量显示女性割礼自发凸显性增加，但未出现再创伤迹象。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了教育娱乐在政府缺乏可信本地信使时的有效性机制；区分了不同议题（是否有中介反对）下教育娱乐效果差异的理论逻辑；引入大语言模型作为大规模非侵入式测量工具的方法论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种通过娱乐节目改变有害习俗的有效策略；提出将开放式测量纳入实验评估的伦理可行的非侵入式方法，减少对受访者的潜在伤害。

title: The Semiconductors Race-Understanding the Challenges in India’s Technology and Industrial Ecosystem, and Learning From Global Strategies

detail.title: The Semiconductors Race-Understanding the Challenges in India’s Technology and Industrial Ecosystem, and Learning From Global Strategies
detail.abstract: Semiconductors have transitioned from a technological input to a strategic asset, underpinning economic competitiveness and national security. The COVID-19 pandemic exposed the vulnerabilities of a geographically concentrated global semiconductor supply chain, accelerating the “semiconductors race” worldwide. India has also launched its own policy architecture through the India Semiconductor Mission. This study argues that the semiconductor industry is shaped by three mutually reinforcing forces – Technology, Industry, and Geopolitics – and that national semiconductor strategies succeed or fail depending on whether these three pillars are mutually interacting with each other. Drawing on the historical trajectories of countries that have fared strongly in the semiconductor industry, this study uses the three-pillar framework and applies it as a diagnostic tool to evaluate India's semiconductor ambitions. Applied to India, the diagnostic reveals structural weaknesses across all three pillars. India's R&D spending at 0.7% of GDP, less private sector participation in R&D, weak industry-academia linkages, and a projected shortfall of 2.5 to 3 lakh semiconductor professionals by 2027 point to a fragile technology pillar. India's electronics manufacturing base, despite its recent growth, remains in low-value assembly with domestic value addition as low as 15-20%, and infrastructure bottlenecks in power, water, and land constrain its industrial pillar. And while India has built a significant diplomatic architecture through the TRUST initiative, Quad, Pax Silica, and bilateral agreements with Taiwan, Japan, and Singapore, the technology being transferred is limited to mature nodes, and India's ties with Russia create a credibility gap that limits deeper integration into the US-led semiconductor alliance network. This study recommends a sequenced approach for India: Prioritizing ATMP and design in the short term, expanding the downstream industrial base and reforming the R&D ecosystem in the medium term, and aligning fabrication expansion with ecosystem maturity in the long term.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了"技术-产业-地缘政治"三支柱框架，用以分析国家半导体战略的成败。将该框架应用于印度后，发现印度在三个支柱上均存在结构性弱点，并提出了分阶段的发展建议。
AI.research_question: 印度半导体战略在技术、产业与地缘政治三个维度上存在哪些结构性弱点？如何评估并改进其半导体政策架构？
AI.motivation: 半导体已从技术投入演变为战略资产，新冠疫情暴露了全球供应链地理集中的脆弱性，各国竞相发展半导体产业。印度虽已通过"印度半导体使命"启动政策布局，但其战略能否成功尚缺乏系统性的诊断框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三支柱框架：半导体产业由技术（Technology）、产业（Industry）和地缘政治（Geopolitics）三种相互强化的力量共同塑造，国家半导体战略的成功与否取决于这三者是否彼此有效互动。
AI.method: 基于历史比较分析，借鉴半导体产业表现强劲国家的历史轨迹，将三支柱框架作为诊断工具对印度进行案例评估。
AI.findings: （1）技术支柱薄弱：印度研发支出仅占GDP的0.7%，私营部门研发参与度低，产学研联系弱，预计2027年半导体专业人才缺口达25-30万；（2）产业支柱受限：电子制造以低附加值组装为主，国内附加值仅15-20%，且面临电力、水和土地等基础设施瓶颈；（3）地缘政治受限：虽通过TRUST倡议、四方安全对话、Pax Silica等构建了外交架构，但技术转移局限于成熟节点，且对俄关系造成信誉缺口，限制了深度融入美国主导的半导体联盟网络。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"技术-产业-地缘政治"三支柱互动框架，为分析国家半导体战略提供了一个系统性的诊断工具，超越了单一维度的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度半导体战略提供了分阶段路线图：短期优先发展ATMP（封测）与设计；中期扩大下游工业基础并改革研发生态系统；长期在生态系统成熟后再扩大晶圆制造产能。

title: The Lived Experiences Of The Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team In Kibungan, Benguet
affiliations: King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines, King’s College of the Philippines and King’s College of the Philippines

detail.title: The Lived Experiences Of The Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team In Kibungan, Benguet
detail.abstract: This study explored the lived experiences of Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team (BPAT) members in selected barangays of Kibungan, Benguet. It aimed to identify the challenges they encounter and the coping mechanisms they employ in carrying out their duties. The findings indicated that BPAT members face several challenges, including youth engagement in vices, limited road accessibility and transportation, curfew-related concerns, public disturbances, and instances of disrespect from community members. Among these, youth involvement in vices emerged as the most significant challenge. To address these difficulties, BPAT members rely on coping mechanisms, such as seeking support and guidance from law enforcement authorities, demonstrating resilience through patience and hard work, and fostering unity and a heart of service. Based on the findings, the study concludes that addressing youth engagement in vices remains a critical concern. Therefore, it is highly recommended that the Municipality of Kibungan enhance BPAT incentives through increased financial support. The Municipality is also encouraged to implement proactive community-oriented activities, such as clean-up drives, team-building, and sports programs. Furthermore, the Local Government Unit (LGU) is encouraged to conduct anti-vice seminars and campaigns and launch youth development programs. In addition, the municipality is encouraged to provide functional radios or communication devices, flashlights, reflective vests, and basic first aid kits to ensure safety and efficiency during patrols and emergency responses.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了菲律宾Kibungan镇Barangay维和行动队（BPAT）成员的工作经历，识别出他们面临的主要挑战（以青少年参与恶习最为突出）及应对机制，并提出了加强激励、开展社区活动和提供装备等政策建议。
AI.research_question: Barangay维和行动队（BPAT）成员在执行职责时面临哪些挑战？他们采用了哪些应对机制？
AI.motivation: 基层维和人员（BPAT）在社区安全中发挥重要作用，但他们的工作困境和应对策略尚未得到充分研究，尤其是在菲律宾农村基层治理的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生活经验（lived experiences）视角；应对机制（coping mechanisms）理论
AI.method: 质性研究方法，通过对Kibungan镇选定Barangay的BPAT成员进行访谈，探索其生活经验。
AI.findings: BPAT成员面临五大挑战：青少年参与恶习、道路可达性和交通受限、宵禁相关问题、公共秩序干扰、社区成员不尊重行为，其中青少年恶习问题最为严重。应对机制包括：寻求执法部门支持与指导、依靠耐心和努力工作展现韧性、培养团结和服务精神。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于基层社区维和人员（尤其是菲律宾Barangay层面）工作困境与应对策略的质性研究，为"生活经验"视角在公共安全管理领域的应用提供了实证案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议地方政府增加BPAT成员的财政激励；开展社区清洁、团队建设和体育项目等主动式社区活动；举办反恶习研讨会和青年发展项目；为BPAT成员配备无线电、手电筒、反光背心和急救包等基本装备。

title: Learning via Routing: Regret-Estimation Trade-offs in Route-Constrained Combinatorial Bandits
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong (HKU), , Beijing Jiaotong University - School of Economics and Management  and The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Learning via Routing: Regret-Estimation Trade-offs in Route-Constrained Combinatorial Bandits
detail.abstract: We introduce and study the route-constrained combinatorial bandit problem, a new combinatorial multiarmed bandit model in which each super arm must be realized as a feasible route on a spatial network. In each period, a learner selects a budget-constrained route and observes semi-bandit rewards only at the visited locations. This route-induced action space captures mobile operational settings such as retailing on wheels and mobile healthcare outreach. Beyond the standard goal of regret minimization, we study a closely coupled objective: full-map estimation, which requires the learner to accurately recover the reward landscape over the entire network. We show that these two objectives exhibit an intrinsic trade-off. Specifically, we establish a worst-case lower bound eµ(T) Reg * µ (T) = Ω(1) via route-geometric hard instances. We then design a learning policy that combines route-based coverage with optimistic route selection. Under an (α, β)approximation routing oracle, the policy achieves eµ(T) Reg µ,α,β (T) = O(1); in the exact-oracle case, this matches the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. We further demonstrate the breadth of the framework through three operationally motivated and technically distinct variants: multi-objective reward-and-edge-cost routing, where the learner estimates both node rewards and edge costs under a Pareto criterion; switching environments, where unknown regime changes require detection and re-learning of the spatial reward map; and risk-aware route evaluation, where route utilities depend on both reward means and variability. For each variant, we design a tailored route-constrained learning policy and establish tight regret-estimation guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究了路由约束组合赌博机问题，分析了遗憾最小化与全地图估计两个目标之间的内在权衡，设计了基于路由覆盖与乐观选择的策略，并在多个变体中扩展了该框架。
AI.research_question: 在空间网络中，学习者选择预算约束的可行路由并观察半赌博奖励时，如何同时实现遗憾最小化与全网络奖励分布准确恢复？
AI.motivation: 移动零售、移动医疗等移动运营场景中，决策者需要在空间网络上规划路线并收集沿途奖励信息，现有组合赌博机模型未考虑路由约束带来的行动空间结构，因此需要建立新模型并分析学习目标间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路由约束组合赌博机模型；组合多臂赌博机；半赌博反馈；遗憾最小化与全地图估计的权衡分析；基于路由覆盖的乐观选择策略
AI.method: 理论建模与下界分析（构造路由几何困难实例）；设计结合路由覆盖与乐观路由选择的学习策略；在近似路由预言机（α,β）下分析遗憾界；扩展至多目标奖励-边成本路由、切换环境、风险感知路由三个变体
AI.findings: 遗憾最小化与全地图估计存在内在权衡，下界为Ω(1)；所设计策略在近似预言机下达到O(1)遗憾，在精确预言机下匹配下界（仅差对数因子）；三个变体均获得紧的遗憾-估计保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出路由约束组合赌博机模型，刻画了空间网络行动空间的独特结构；揭示了遗憾最小化与全地图估计两个学习目标间的基本权衡；建立了路由几何困难实例的下界分析框架；将框架扩展至多目标、环境切换、风险感知三个重要运营场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移动零售、移动医疗等移动运营场景提供了理论指导下的学习算法，帮助决策者在路径规划中同时优化累积回报与了解全局环境；支持多目标权衡、动态环境适应及风险敏感决策等实际需求。

title: A Multidimensional National Defence and Strategic Resilience Framework for Saudi Arabia in the Aftermath of the 2026 Iran–GCC Conflict

detail.title: A Multidimensional National Defence and Strategic Resilience Framework for Saudi Arabia in the Aftermath of the 2026 Iran–GCC Conflict
detail.abstract: The 2026 Iran-Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) conflict-initiated on 28 February 2026 by joint United States and Israeli military operations against Iran under the codenames Operation Epic Fury and Operation Roaring Lion respectively (Britannica 2026; The Soufan Center 2026)-has constituted the most consequential operational stress-test of Gulf Arab state defence architecture in modern history. For the first time since the 1990-1991 Gulf crisis, all six GCC member states were simultaneously targeted by Iranian ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and one-way attack drones in a sustained multi-week campaign. United States and Gulf partner forces collectively expended in excess of 1,800 Patriot interceptors in the first sixteen days alone (Aerotime 2026), at a unit cost of approximately USD 4.2-5.3 million per PAC-3 Missile Segment Enhancement round (Norsk Luftvern 2026; TWZ 2026), creating an adverse cost-exchange ratio that is fiscally unsustainable at scale. This paper presents a comprehensive ground-executable multidimensional national defence and strategic resilience framework engineered specifically for Saudi Arabia. The framework is organised across eight mutually reinforcing strategic pillars-layered air and missile defence; critical infrastructure hardening; accelerated indigenous defence industrialisation; supply chain sovereignty; GCC integrated command; cybersecurity, electronic warfare and C5ISR; sovereign space-based situational awareness; and civil defence and societal resilience-over an indicative ten-year investment envelope of approximately USD 131 billion (2026-2035), of which an estimated USD 42-50 billion represents net additional sovereign investment beyond foreign procurement displacement. The principal analytical contribution is the integration of two distinct empirical streams: (i) the documented operational record of the first 96 hours of Operation Epic Fury and its aftermath, including the geographic distribution of Iranian strikes across the Eastern Province, Riyadh, and the Ras Tanura refining complex; and (ii) the demonstrated efficacy of Ukrainian counter-drone doctrine, in which interceptor drones such as the Wild Hornets Sting platform have achieved 80-90 percent kill rates against Shahed-type loitering munitions at unit costs of USD 1,400-2,500 (Defense Innovation Review 2026; Fox News 2026). The author argues that Saudi Arabia possesses the financial, institutional, and political prerequisites to translate the post-conflict urgency into durable strategic autonomy, contingent on the establishment of a National Defence Transformation Council within sixty days and the activation of a National Counter-Drone Emergency Programme through the newly-launched SAMI Autonomous Company (SAMI 2026a; Defensehere 2026).
